NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Equipped to protect and destroy! My Klepto-matons!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_2: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}You're gonna have to do more than use my own cards against us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}We're onto you, Greed Guy! Me and the other Daves!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_4: {SAY:greedy}Seems like I oughta take some drastic measures.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_6: {SAY:greedy}Why, when I had lotsa money I made some wise investments.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}What's a rich fella like me without some body guards??
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{SAY:greedy}Oh boy... That uuuh. That sure didn't go how I expected.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Heh-heh. A simple jest of mine. All in good fun.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_11: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Greedy... Oh Greedy. You're going to stay here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_12: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}And by the time I am done with your punishment...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_13: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}The residents of this world will believe you to be a god of generosity!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_16: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}What did I tell you about crossing a god?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_17: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Ahem... Daves, neighbors, you're free to go!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_18: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}The gaps back to your dimensions are opening now. Thank you for your help!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}You're done. But for me, it's only the beginning.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}Oh, look at that, a sandwich! But I said I didn't want one!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}A deal's a deal. You've more than proven yourself, Crazy Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I've even personally decorated it to reflect the dimension you came from!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}A reminder of this special occasion! As stressful as it was.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_9: {SAY:greedy}Now then... Gulp... I know you know that stuff about me takin' ova' the market was just a big joke.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Alright, I reached into the depths of my mind to pull out the memory of us ending up here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_10: {SAY:crazydave}What? Is this another one of those timey-wimey dimensional situations...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_12: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}This is the Lunar Rainbow Market, a market that only opens under a Moonbow.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_13: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}However, something has gone terribly wrong this time around.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_14: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Strange creatures that don't appear to be youkai nor human.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_15: {SAY:crazydave}Strange creatures? Oh, those are just zombies, I fight them almost every day!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_16: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Your other selves have told me as much. They have been causing chaos!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}Well, if that's the reason why you got hold of me, you got the right man for the job!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_19: {SAY:crazydave}Wait, why do those zombies have wings?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Last I remember I was just taking a snooze, some weird portal opened...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_20: {AWKWARD:tenkyuchimata}I am not sure. Judging from your reaction though, they don't have wings normally?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_21: {SAY:crazydave}They ride on weird bugs but... not really.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_22: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Well, strange things occur here all the time. It's quite good for me, actually.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_23: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Regardless, these zombies have gained wings similar to fairies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_24: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}They flutter about this world and are numerous.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_25: {SAY:crazydave}Oh, I always wanted to see a fairy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_4: {NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}There's another one of you? Just how many are there?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Woah! Who are you? Why do you look like that?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I come from a different universe than what you're used to.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}A lot of things may seem bizarre until you two adjust.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}My name is Chimata Tenkyuu, and I run this market.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}This isn't the first time I have met one of you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Chimata! I found a new plant at this market!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_10: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}With both heartbreak and lovesickness, they become completely heartbroken.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_11: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Which makes them more vulnerable to your plants'... danmaku?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}Begonia? Those symbolise friendship and bond, but can also mean misfortune.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}So... what does it do? This is usually when Penny would fill me in.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}From what I have gathered, it manipulates both ice and fire...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Straight in the heart? That's gotta hurt.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Ice will cause heartbreak, hampering their ability to move.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_9: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Fire will cause lovesickness, crippling their strength.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:crazydave}So from what you have told me...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_10: {AWKWARD:tenkyuchimata}I think one of the sages may have dragged you here...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_11: {TIRED:crazydave}Well, that was kind of rude. I was just relaxing in my hammock.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_12: {SAY:crazydave}But zombies are dangerous if you're unprepared, that's for sure.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}I don't know. You brought me here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}This is kind of your mess, isn't it?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_18: {SAY:crazydave}And usually I require some kind of... motivation to clean up a mess.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}I have ended up in another world, along with other Crazy Daves?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_20: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I can give you any of the various delicacies in this world, is there anything you would like?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_22: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Well? I am a little desperate here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_25: {SAY:crazydave}Sandwich. But a cool-looking one. Like in the commercials.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_26: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I hate the modern day market and their commercials...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_27: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Alright, after this is all done, I will give you the most special sandwich.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_3: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Yes. And now that you're here, I am going to need your help to save the market.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_30: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Just keep fighting off these zombies like you know best.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_31: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Thanks to this incident, my level of faith has been going down and so I can't do much on my own.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_32: {EXCITED:crazydave}No time to lose hope! Crazy Dave is on the job!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_33: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}No, I mean the faith in myself. As a goddess, I require faith for power as well as my life.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_34: {SAY:crazydave}Oooooh, that must be why you look like that!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_35: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I've got to look the part for my role as a goddess, of course.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_36: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Anyway, there are many gods in this world, requiring faith as much as I do.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_37: {SAY:crazydave}Now hold on a minute, I see zombies with dusters!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_38: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Those are besoms. They surely intend to sweep your plants away.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_39: {SAY:crazydave}No time for chit-chat! Time for zombie fightin'!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Along with your neighbor and the other Daves.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_5: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}One of your "zombies" was able to get here and he's been making a mess.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Faith in the market and myself is weakening as a result.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I can't let all the faith I have gathered vanish again...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_8: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}So I am going to need you, your neighbor and the other Daves.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_9: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Not to worry, I will help you all get back home after this incident is resolved.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}But you're too late, see? I've already gotsa the goods.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_11: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}You! You must be the one behind this incident.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}Let's just say... One o' my side-gigs really paid off.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}All this "interdimensional" stuffs is outta my mind and sight usually, but oh, this market!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_14: {SAY:greedy}Why, when I found out about it, I was gigglin' like a candy-stuffed baby!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}My sources been tellin' me that it's got the power of ownership itself at its heart.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_16: {SAY:greedy}And really, it was easy to exploit. I stumbled on the right dimension, I tell ya'.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_17: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}To use my power like that, crossing a god is dangerous you know...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_18: {SAY:greedy}Oh, please. You ain't all that. If you were, you wouldn't have needed all those "Daves" fightin' your battles.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_19: {SAY:greedy}And it seems you ain't destined to be any kind of "god of ownership" or whatever. No, someone else here seems to be a much better fit for that title...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}I noticed, most of our plants are gone!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_21: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{SAY:greedy}That someone else is me, that's what I meant.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_24: {EXCITED:crazydave}I know that guy, he's spoiled rotten!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_26: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I want to punish him for these acts, but I am too weak to do so.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_27: {SAY:crazydave}Let's just use what we have to fight off these zombies for now.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_28: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I will help restore the ownership of your plants as well.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_3: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Luckily the ones at my market are still around, but...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}All the ones that belonged to you have lost their ownership completely.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_5: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Only I have the power to relinquish ownership, which means someone else has used my card...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_7: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{SAY:greedy}Well, well, well. If it isn't my very own fatso gardener.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_9: {SAY:greedy}I had a feelin' that weird lass woulda brought you here too sooner or later.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}It seems like a plant from last night wishes to be in your neighbor's ownership.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_6_INTRO_2: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}This Cheese Strawberry can lob cheese to lower the attack power of Zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}What are these boxes with rainbows on them?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Quite a sight, I gotta say. Nice craftsmanship.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_11: {SAY:greedy}They'll be good for shuttin' you up!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}You and those other "Daves" you brought here to annoy me!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}I've already activated some of 'em, toots. They're doin' good work.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_14: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}The ability cards were not meant to be used like this! Once I get my hands on you...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}You won't. Those hands won't be yours anymore either.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_16: {SAY:greedy}This market's giving you all your power, the faith in "ownership" and the like.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_17: {SAY:greedy}Least that's what my professional's tellin' me.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_18: {SAY:greedy}But if all that faith goes to me instead, I'll own it all!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}A remnant of an old incident of mine...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_5: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}They mimic the powers of others, but only a small fraction.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}They may help us out, or make things more difficult.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_7: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{SAY:greedy}Oh, they're gonna make things more difficult, alright.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}I'm beginning to get more and more power over ownership thanks to ya'.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_9: {SAY:greedy}And that includes those cards o' yours!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}So just who is this Greedy? Is he just another robber looking to ruin my market?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_10: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}And in other dimensions as well... He'll have universal access from here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}He won't stop until he has everything.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:crazydave}One time he even stole Feastivus spirit from everyone!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}And just because he wanted to be the most cheerful! Can you imagine that?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_14: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}If he has such a desire to own everything...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_15: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}He would undoubtedly launch zombie assaults on other dimensions to own as much as possible.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}And I got some personal stuff to deal with him! He stole my car once!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_17: {EXCITED:crazydave}And my car is my best friend!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_18: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}That "car" must be a precious possession of yours.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_19: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Well that aside, we have a new threat. They appear to be princesses.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}He's a mobster zombie obsessed with wanting to have everything for himself.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_20: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}They can cloak other zombies using their fans.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_21: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Similar to how Kappa use Optical Camouflage.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_22: {SAY:crazydave}What does royalty have to do with being invisible?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_23: {SAY:crazydave}Now that I think about it, I don't think I have ever seen a princess in my life.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}I've faced a lot of kooky characters like him recently.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}And he wants to own everything in the market...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_5: {AWKWARD:tenkyuchimata}Has he not learned ownership isn't so easily passed?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}He is trying to break the natural order of ownership...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}...and I don't have the power to stop it yet.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}If he wins this, it sounds like he's getting the position of zombie leader too!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's gonna cause some serious trouble back at home!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}It seems we received an offering from the Moriya Miko
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_10: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Hmph! You would even go as low as to steal a god's offerings.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_11: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Do you have any idea on what kind of karma this could bring you?!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}Karma? You mean the stuff on those stupid websites?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}I need that donation, thank you. This is something we call "an open invitation" in the business.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_14: {SAY:greedy}I won't let it fall because of a couple of... Daves!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}I'm livin' it up now! I have servants, maids, minions...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_17: {SAY:greedy}The maids, the servants, they're all MINE!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_18: {SAY:greedy}There's even aristocrats who are willing to chit-chat and exchange pleasantries with me now. Shows I truly own more than anyone.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_19: {SAY:greedy}Ain't a chance I'm giving this life up now, and it's only gonna be gettin' better.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_20: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Alright Greedy, I am going to give you one chance to listen.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_21: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}You want to own everything... But what will there be to own once you have it all?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_22: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}You will own all possessions. But then you will seek more. You will want it all.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_23: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}You will chase the highs of ownership, seeking to fill that hole in you just ONE more time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_24: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Until there is nothing left. To own all is to own nothing.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_25: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Greed seeks eternity. Seeks deep, deep, eternity.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_26: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}It will never be satisfied. You will never be satisfied.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_28: {SAY:greedy}Once your precious market will be mine.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_32: {SAY:greedy}It'll be mine, mine, mine, mine, MINE!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_33: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{AWKWARD:tenkyuchimata}Why did I even bother? They are all the same...

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny, I don't know how much longer I can keep it together!

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_12: {NPC_ENTER:captaincamo}{PLAYFUL:captaincamo}Oh, how I knew this would happen.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_17: {EXCITED:captaincamo}You common gardeners haven't faced real war!

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_19: {EXCITED:captaincamo}I gave this place a makeover of the century!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}This war world is unlike anything I've seen before!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}General Camo, your threats are well and good-

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_22: {SAY:winnie}Have you caused changes to this era?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_24: {SAY:captaincamo}See, this time period holds some of my fondest memories.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_25: {SAY:captaincamo}I used to command all of this when I was in my youth.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_26: {SAY:captaincamo}Before I needed to wear this mask...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_27: {SAY:captaincamo}There was a brief period in history where I was on top of the world.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_28: {SAY:captaincamo}And had the resources to deal with nitwits like you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}To add insult to injury, I'm detecting an imminent assault of zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_30: {SAY:captaincamo}My younger self has already decided on a full frontal assault.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_31: {SAY:captaincamo}I suppose "if you want something done, do it yourself" really does apply.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_32: {SAY:captaincamo}I'll let him do the job and watch from the sidelines.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_36: {SAY:winnie}Actually, it puts things into context quite accurately.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_37: {SAY:winnie}The General Camo we know baited us into this time period.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_38: {SAY:winnie}So that his past self could "take care of us" back when he had immense resources.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_45: {SAY:crazydave}I think I need to practice my battle cry.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}I am unable to retrieve that data at this time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}We were meant to get in here, rescue whoever sent the distress signal-
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}That General Guy is out of his mind!

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_29: {SAY:captaincamo}Soon you'll see that what I used to wear was more than a fashion choice.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_14: {SAY:captaincamo}To think... if I manage to bring all of this back to the present...

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_18: {SAY:captaincamo}But first... I'll finish what I started here.
